title: Strongly positive bases and quantum greedy expansions
summary: We prove that every element of a strongly positive basis of a coefficient-free rank-two quantum cluster algebra has nonnegative Laurent-polynomial coefficients in the quantum greedy basis. This establishes the strongly positive basis assertion of Conjecture 16 of Lee, Li, Rupel, and Zelevinsky. We also give a counterexample to their Conjecture 13(b).
